metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: QEFWUX crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group I m m m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C128 H262 N24 O188 Sm33 1+,C2 H3 O2 1-,52(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Sm1 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm2 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm3 (Sm) has 10 O neighbors; Sm4 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm5 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm6 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm7 (Sm) has 7 O neighbors; Sm8 (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm1A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm2A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm3A (Sm) has 10 O neighbors; Sm4A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm5A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm6A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm7A (Sm) has 7 O neighbors; Sm8A (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm1B (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm2B (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm3B (Sm) has 10 O neighbors; Sm4B (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm5B (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm6B (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm7B (Sm) has 7 O neighbors; Sm8B (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm1C (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm2C (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm3C (Sm) has 10 O neighbors; Sm4C (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm5C (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm6C (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm7C (Sm) has 7 O neighbors; Sm8C (Sm) has 9 O neighbors; Sm6H (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm6I (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm6J (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm6K (Sm) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 110 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 0.735-5.670 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 14.52-178.74°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Sm33(EDTA)12(OAc)2(CO3)4(μ3-OH)36(μ5-OH)4(H2O)38]·OAc·approximately 50H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 36 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 μ5-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 38 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
